note: Produced by real seeded natural selection inside the shipped simulation. Medium is the retained deployed baseline (its held-out measurements are recorded); Hard is the best evolved candidate. Easy is the weakest measured candidate from the sampled archive plus a bounded weakening search, played against the baseline on its own seeds, and is only labelled measured weaker when its own numbers say so.

fitness.formula: (winner ? 2 : 0) + tiles / landTiles + 0.5 * cities / (own + opponent cities); averaged over matches
fitness.seats: every pair plays both faction assignments on every seed
fitness.cap: 10 simulated minutes per match, real victory ends it earlier

easy.origin: weakest measured candidate on the easy seeds: 'weak-15' from weakening search, gen 2; mean score 0.3276 vs baseline self-play 1.7191 over 8 games [seeds 8302,8404,8506,8608], win rate 0 - measured weaker than the retained baseline Medium by 1.3915

medium.origin: retained deployed baseline (compatibility: existing default gameplay) - evaluated on the same held-out seeds: rank 6/6, mean score 1.7249

hard.origin: best evolved candidate: evolved candidate 'final-top1' (validation rank 1/6, mean score 2.9056 vs baseline 0.5313, win rate 1)
